name: parse a causal graph and derive all minimal adjustment sets for a target effect
definition: Use a graph-analysis API to find the minimal adjustment sets satisfying the back-door criterion for the causal effect between a named pair, excluding forbidden nodes.
failure_mode: Wrong adjustment sets or nonexistent/malformed file.

name: parse an html document to list financial metrics and their rows
definition: Extract financial metric figures from an HTML report and associate each with its row/cell position.
failure_mode: misidentifying the row of the anomalous metric fails
